text: The former Municipality of Metropolitan Toronto (City of Toronto) entered into an agreement (municipal agreement) on October 22, 1965, for the development and operation of 160 social housing units for low-income seniors at 444 Logan Avenue, Ray McCleary Towers, a project owned and operated by WoodGreen Community Housing Incorporated (WoodGreen). The project was funded under a former federal social housing Operating Agreement which expired on July 1, 2017, when the original Canada Mortgage and Housing Corporation (CMHC) mortgage was discharged. The municipal agreement provided that upon mortgage expiry, the property is to be reconveyed to the City of Toronto (City).
